page.overview:
Who is Granny Smith?

Granny Smith's human counterpart appears in the My Little Pony Equestria Girls franchise. She is Applejack, Apple Bloom, and Big McIntosh's grandmother and a teacher/lunch lady at Canterlot High School.

Granny Smith makes a brief appearance in My Little Pony Equestria Girls, as the lunch lady at Canterlot High School. She appears to be far more heavyset than her pony self.

In the film, Granny Smith has a cameo passing outside the human world version of Sweet Apple Acres using two apple cores as earplugs to drown out the Rainbooms' poorly performed song.

Granny Smith appears asking Principal Celestia for help with a "cafeteria crisis" in Subs Rock and working in the school cafeteria in The Art of Friendship. She is also mentioned in Applejack's anecdote in Epic Fails.
